Title: Adding analyzer to analyze its own project in which it is created?
Description: Hello, thank you for your help.

Imagine the following scenario: I create a project called "AnalyzerProject" in which a analyzer gets defined.
Is it possible to use this very same analyzer to analyze the very same project?
So that this analyzer that gets build analyzes the project "AnalyzerProject"?

If so, how can I make this happen?
I have three projects in my solution, a analyzer project (net standard 2.0), a code fixes project (net standard 2.0), a package project (which combines both, and is also net standard 2.0), and a vsix project (so that I can test the analyzer by starting another visual studio instance. This one is a net472 project). I am sure you know what I mean. How can I make it happen so that all these 4 projects inside my solution are analyzed by the analyzer that is defined inside the projects themselves?
